title: Arkade Developers Ltd - 544261 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

summary.headline: Arkade posted record Q4 FY26 pre-sales of Rs 303 crore (+40% YoY), but FY26 PAT fell to Rs 5 crore after a Rs 182 crore Filmistan tenancy-rights write-off.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue rose 48% YoY to Rs 199 crore with EBITDA of Rs 38 crore (19.4% margin), and Q4 pre-sales hit a record Rs 303 crore. FY26 revenue grew 19.2% to Rs 828 crore with EBITDA of Rs 189 crore (23.2% margin), but PAT was only Rs 5 crore after a one-time exceptional item of about Rs 182 crore linked to the Filmistan tenancy rights. Management flagged the Filmistan project (GDV Rs 3,500 crore) and a Kandivali cluster redevelopment MoU (GDV Rs 1,100 crore) as the next growth drivers. On the call, management said May pre-sales were slower due to war, fuel price and global macro pressures.

financial_highlights.change: +40% YoY vs Rs 217 crore in Q4 FY25
After exceptional item of ~Rs 182 crore (tenancy rights) and tax provision of Rs 2 crore

segments.name: Filmistan project (Goregaon West)
segments.commentary: Land bought for Rs 165 crore; tenancy rights valued at ~Rs 182.6 crore and merged into Arkade after a March 2026 demerger order, leading to the Rs 182.17 crore exceptional write-off. Planned uber-luxury residential project with GDV Rs 3,500 crore and estimated Rs 1,000-1,200 crore cumulative bottom-line contribution over 3-5 years.

segments.name: Kandivali cluster redevelopment (Ashok Nagar)
segments.commentary: MoU signed for cluster redevelopment of 9 societies, RERA carpet area ~3.25 lakh sq ft, projected GDV Rs 1,100 crore. Rights not yet secured on signing; listed as one of two cluster projects driving growth.

segments.name: Thane project
segments.commentary: Management said it will be launched in FY27, expected to drive a growth spike in the next year. No GDV or unit details were given.

guidance_outlook: Management targets an EBITDA margin of around 25% (CFO later said 27-28% on stabilisation) and a PAT margin of 18-19%.
Pipeline of about Rs 12,000 crore spread over the next 5-6 years; management expects 20-25% YoY growth, with FY27 at 20-25%.
Filmistan project launch targeted by financial year-end FY27 (subject to approvals); Thane project launch planned in FY27.
Growth expected to become exponential in FY28 and FY29 once Filmistan and Thane contribute for a full year.
Management said the Filmistan and Thane projects plus two cluster redevelopment projects will drive exponential growth; Rs 12,000 crore pipeline to be recognised over about six years.
capex_capacity: Added approx. 20% manpower in the front-ending execution and sales team to support the growth plan.
Filmistan land acquisition (Rs 165 crore) fully paid in January; tenancy rights write-off to reduce the future project cost of the Filmistan project, per the CFO.
Balanced pipeline of redevelopment and strategic land acquisition across MMR micro-markets; no capex or capacity figures disclosed.
demand_pricing: Luxury share of MMR sales rose to 44% in 9M FY26 by area, from 31% in FY21; luxury expected to dominate FY27 launches.
Properties priced Rs 2-5 crore now dominate sales; sub-Rs 1 crore homes have shrunk as a share of sales.
Years-to-sell at a historic low of about 1.2-1.4 years; periphery hubs (Thane, Navi Mumbai, Mira Road) gaining traction.
Management said May 2026 pre-sales were consistent but slower due to war, fuel price and global economic pressures, and not above the Q4 growth rate of 40%.

qa_highlights.question: When will there be more clarity on the Filmistan project?
qa_highlights.answer: Project is under approval; launch targeted by financial year-end (FY27).

qa_highlights.question: What EBITDA margin is targeted going forward?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman said around 25%; CFO said EBITDA margin should stabilise at 27-28% and PAT margin at 18-19%.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Rs 182 crore tenancy-rights diminution a one-off or does it carry financial implications?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said it is a one-off; after the March 2026 demerger order, tenancy rights (cost ~Rs 183 crore) merged into Arkade and the value diminished, and the amount will reduce the Filmistan project cost going forward.

qa_highlights.question: Revenue guidance for next 2-3 years?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO cited Rs 12,000 crore pipeline over 5-6 years and 20-25% YoY growth; FY27 growth expected at 20-25%, with exponential growth in FY28-29 as Filmistan and Thane contribute.

qa_highlights.question: How long to recognise the ~Rs 12,000 crore pipeline and does the math support 5,000-6,000 crore of cumulative revenue at 25% CAGR?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman said around six years is targeted and cited Thane, Filmistan and two cluster projects driving exponential growth; CFO clarified the 25% applies to next year only and FY27 is 20-25%, with the step-up in FY28-29. No cumulative figure was reconciled.

qa_highlights.question: How have May pre-sales been?
qa_highlights.answer: Chairman said consistent but slower, citing war, fuel prices and the global economy; said growth is definitely not above Q4's 40%, and Q4 is seasonally stronger than Q1.

risks_watch: Exceptional Rs 182 crore charge depressed FY26 PAT to Rs 5 crore; margin guidance is inconsistent (25% vs 27-28% EBITDA) and needs clarification.
Collections grew only 2% YoY to Rs 728 crore in FY26 against 17% pre-sales growth, so cash conversion lags sales.
Filmistan and Thane launches depend on approvals and FY27 timelines; the Ashok Nagar cluster is only an MoU, not yet a secured right.
May 2026 pre-sales slowed due to geopolitical and fuel price pressures; watch Q1 FY27 sales.
Management's cumulative revenue and growth math (Rs 12,000 crore over ~6 years) was not clearly reconciled on the call.
Filmistan Rs 3,500 crore GDV and Rs 1,000-1,200 crore bottom-line contribution remain estimates, subject to approvals and design.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on luxury demand, pipeline and the Filmistan opportunity, but cautious on near-term sales, citing war, fuel and macro headwinds. Answers on margin targets and multi-year growth were inconsistent and were not clearly reconciled, and several answers were loose.
key_quotes: We achieved highest-ever quarterly pre-sales of Rs. 303 crores for Q4 FY26, a growth of 40% on year-on-year basis, vis-à-vis Rs. 217 crores in Q4 FY25.
We strongly believe that value creation in real estate does not come merely from owning land, it comes from timely execution, customer trust and delivering projects with consistency and quality.
Consistent only. They are a little slow because of the war impact and the fuel prices impact and the global economical situation.

adds.what: Filmistan uber-luxury residential project (GDV Rs 3,500 crore), launch targeted by FY27 year-end subject to approvals
Thane project launch in FY27 (no GDV or unit details given)

growth.why: Management guides 20-25% revenue growth for FY27 backed by a Rs 12,000 crore pipeline, Filmistan (GDV Rs 3,500 crore, launch by FY27 year-end subject to approvals) and Thane (FY27 launch), but the Kandivali MoU rights are not yet secured and no capex or capacity figures were given, so backing is partial.
